Interface ServerNetworkAdapter

All Superinterfaces:
ServerNotifier
All Known Implementing Classes:
HybridServerNetworkAdapter, RMIServerNetworkAdapter, SocketServerNetworkAdapter
public interface ServerNetworkAdapter extends ServerNotifier
Abstraction for server-side network adapters (RMI, Socket, or hybrid).
